document.about: Lutron Maestro LED+ dimmer submittal sheet. On page 2 its ratings list joins items with an `or` set bold italic at the items' hanging indent.

notes: #265: once #230 read the `or` as bold, a weight change parted it from a two-line item above it, whose second line is the shorter, and the list was cut in two. A lowercase line hanging under an item goes on with it, full line or not.

checks.issue: The `or` under the two-line item `Mixed bulb type per Multigang and Mixed Bulb Type Ratings table (see page 3)` was a paragraph of its own.
As above: the item goes on into its `or`.
